segments.text: How many cities have you been to in China?
segments.instructions: Ask a neutral information question with a gentle falling finish.

segments.text: I've been to three big cities in China.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: Will you return to one or two of them? Which? And when?
segments.instructions: Ask a choice question, rising on the first choice and falling on the final choice.

segments.text: I shall return to Beijing next year.
segments.instructions: Use a relaxed natural falling finish for statements.

segments.text: When will you have a haircut?
